_comment: Boards to pre-pull into the local driver library (tools/Build-DriverLibrary.ps1). Each entry: vendor (asus|msi|gigabyte), model, optional slug (Gigabyte needs the rev-slug; get it from Build-GigabyteMapping or config/mapping.json), optional osid (ASUS, default probes). ASRock can't be pulled headlessly (Incapsula) - it stays client browser-fallback. Seeded with the verified vectors; expand toward your current-gen lineup. Tip: generate candidates from config/mapping.json (filter by chipset) to grow this quickly.
